name: Hirakata Aya
source:
Easily excited and up for anything, Aya's willing to take on any challenge- even if it means ending up in over her head, time and again! She puts boundless energy into everything she does.

[from [url=http://www.shira-oka.com/characters/21-hirakata-aya.html]official site[/url]]
